[Thrall And Area52] Damage for all spells has been increased by 15%, healing reduced by 5% while in Battlegrounds.
Improved tooltip of Frost Reserve and fixed an issue where AOE spells were able to consume multiple stacks on single tick (Pending restart)
Fixed an issue where Prayer of Preservation was not interrupted by some boss mechanics (Pending Restart)
Fixed an issue where Aspect of the Monkey did not benefit from T2 Hunter 8 Set bonus (Pending Restart)
Fixed an issue where Titanic Finale was able to ignore ICD for Enrage (Pending restart)
Fixed an issue where REs that caused your pet's basic attacks to deal elemental damage stopped working on level up and needed to be reequipped (Pending restart)

3.description: Added a new command in #help-service section of discord. You can now use !w11dll if you are facing any dll loading issues on newest windows OS.

1.description: [Pending Restart] Aspect of the Viper will now also reduce the effectiveness of Mana Burn.
Fixed an issue where Missile Barrage didn't trigger from Arcane Orb.
Fixed an issue where in certain scenarios you could trigger the Expose Weakness talent with Sinister Strike.

2.description: Jazzik in Ratchet will now offer you a Spelldraft Deck, in the event that yours was misplaced. He is located in Jazzik's General Goods, infront of the Inn.

8.description: [Thrall] [Pending Restart]  - The NPC "Stiletto, the Coinmaster" makes his way to Azeroth. He will be available in Orgrimmar, Stormwind, and Booty Bay near the Mythic Coin Vendor (Edrim Skysong), who will accept your Felstriker (Mythic 1 - 20) in exchange for Mythic Coins, based on the level of the Felstriker. This NPC will only be available for a limited time, as a result of recent changes to the Felstriker proc effect.

0.description: [Thrall / Requires patch] Rare quality pvp gear costs have been dramatically reduced.
[Thrall / Requires patch] Blue pvp gear costs have been dramatically reduced
Issue where Impending Doom was not increasing the damage of Waste has been fixed [Pending Restart]
Issue where Crimson Champion would stack without having Holy Shield (Crimson Champion) active has been fixed [Pending Restart]

5.description: [Area 52][High-Risk] The High-Risk Enchant Dread Assault was recently renamed to Twisted Assault which resulted in two enchants having the same name. Dread Assault has been re-renamed to Twisted Onslaught. (Pending Patch)

7.description: [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where the "Rotting" dot effect from Rotting Breath was not always benefitting from its spell damage or attack power coefficient.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where the regular Feral Instinct capstone was still working when Curse of Arugal was equipped.

5.description: Removed a number of Deprecated Mystic Scrolls from loot templates. You should no longer see unusable Mystic Scrolls.

8.description: [Area 52] [High-Risk] Twisted, Dread and Void Trophy Quests no longer have For the Horde/Alliance, Mercenary or Outlaw restrictions. You can select the tier daily you want now.

[Area 52] [High-Risk] Twisted, Dread and Void Trophy Quests no longer require the event to be active to obtain War Trophies. All creatures that drop Twisted or Void materials now have a chance to drop War Trophies.
[Area 52] [High-Risk] Void War Trophy Quest will now properly drop the quest items from creatures in Tier 3 High-Risk Material Areas.
[Area 52] [High-Risk] Dread War Trophy Quest will now properly drop the quest items from creatures in Tier 2 High-Risk Material Areas.
[Area 52] [High-Risk] Twisted War Trophy Quest will now properly drop the quest items from creatures in High-Risk Material Areas.
